title: How the world is governed: 197 countries, 112 systems
excerpt: Democracy or not is only the first question. Compare head of state, executive, federalism, chambers and voting system, and the world's 197 countries fall into 12 families and 112 exact systems. 80 countries have a system nobody else shares.
seo_description: Every country's system of government, mapped on eight features: 12 families, 112 exact systems, 80 of them unique, beside V-Dem scores.
header_alt: Title card reading 'How the world is governed' in black, red and blue on pale paper, beside a world map with each country coloured by its family of government and federations striped. Text: 197 countries, 12 families; 112 exact systems, 80 held by one country alone; V-Dem v16 and CIA World Factbook.
